subject: Unexpected double-posted requests during deployment — hold invoice and VAT treatment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightlane.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLane Billing <billing@brightlane.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T09:14:00Z
Subject: Spike in tokens — looks like duplicate POSTs during deploy

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We pulled the June 21 usage export and see a ~48% spike in request tokens between 10:12–10:22 UTC for our ingest stream. The traces show the same request IDs being posted twice from BrightLane side while we were doing a blue/green deploy — but your logs show two accept events from different regions. Can you confirm whether Redwood billed both posts?

We attached a small sample CSV with the spike rows (usage_export_20270621.csv). We'd like to pause payment for the disputed lines while you investigate — this is material for our month-end. Also, we're EU-based and plan to apply reverse-charge; we'll need an invoice and credit treatment that supports netting rather than a refund to our card.

TL;DR: Possible duplicate ingestion during our deployment window; please investigate, place disputed lines on hold, and advise on VAT/netting.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Platform — BrightLane

Attachment: usage_export_20270621.csv (CSV stub, 48 rows flagged)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-23T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in tokens — ops findings

Ben / Kim,

Attached is the redacted telemetry for the window and a short root-cause note. Summary:
- We see pairs of identical request-ids accepted ~1s apart from two regional ingress points (eu-west and us-central).
- Cause: during BrightLane's blue/green deploy your client retried to the failover endpoint while the old pool was still draining; our smart-router accepted requests independently in both regions for a short overlap window.
- These look like client-side replay/duplicate submissions rather than internal duplication.

Impact calc (quick):
- ~2,300 duplicated request events flagged; estimated duplicated consumption ~1.9M tokens.
- Ops recommends: confirm duplicates against BrightLane logs, then Finance can issue a provisional credit for duplicated units.

Notes attached: redacted-telemetry-20270621.log and ops-summary-20270623.txt (summary stub).

Connor
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-23T12:20:00Z
Subject: Proposed provisional credit and VAT/netting options

Hi Liam / Aoife — thanks for patience while we investigated. Short summary and next steps: 

Summary:
- Ops confirmed ~2,300 duplicate accepts during 10:12–10:22 UTC on 2027-06-21. Root cause: client-side retries during BrightLane's blue/green deploy; Redwood accepted both regional posts during a brief overlap.
- Total duplicated tokens: ~1.9M tokens.

Finance proposal (choose one):
1) Provisional credit: Redwood will issue a provisional credit for the duplicated token cost (approx. EUR 2,300). We can net this credit against BrightLane's next monthly invoice (preferred for EU reverse-charge bookkeeping).
2) Refund: Redwood can issue a one-off refund to the payment method on file. Note refunds require VAT reversal handling and may take 7–10 business days to appear.

Please confirm which you prefer. If you prefer netting, send your signed PO or confirmation and your VAT/Tax ID so we can issue credit with the proper reverse-charge annotation. Attached: provisional_credit_note_20270623.pdf (draft).

Proposed timeline:
- You confirm preference by EOD 2027-06-24.
- Finance issues final credit note / refund within 3 business days after confirmation and receipt of any required documents (PO, VAT ID).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Acct Exec — Redwood Inference
Direct: +1-415-555-0199

Attachment: provisional_credit_note_20270623.pdf (draft credit note)
